THE MOST IMPORTANT EXCLUSION HERE. This is not an abstraction; it is the Anukramani's own deferral marker -- lingokta, 'stated by the characteristic mark in the mantra' -- standing in the devata slot as a node. Agent 8 counted 102 of these deferrals in Kathyayana's Yajurvedic sutra and treated them as unresolved. Here the same marker has been materialised as a deity and carries 3 dedications across 2 hymns. A community containing `the deities indicated by the wording` would be a community containing a null value. This node is a modelling defect, reported to the lead, not a curation judgement.
